description: We are a team of passionate and curious students interested in space science, astronomy, technology and innovation. We love exploring new ideas, solving challenging problems and learning about space exploration. We welcome enthusiastic and creative team members who are interested in science, coding, research, data analysis and innovative problem-solving. Let's explore, learn and create something meaningful together!
summary: Our project uses Artificial Intelligence to control a smart butterfly model. The AI chip processes input signals and sends control signals through the transmitter and receiver. The battery supplies power, and the motor controls the butterfly movement. We developed this project using MATLAB Simulink. This project demonstrates the use of AI and electronic technology in automation.
